subject: business-studies
title: Marketing Mix Stretch Adventure
welcome_lead: Exam-style stretch. Evaluate promotion methods, distribution choices and an integrated mix.
meta_desc: GCSE Business Studies stretch — promotion methods, distribution and evaluating the marketing mix.
final_note: You can evaluate promotion choices, distribution channels and the consistency of a marketing mix.

concepts.def: Paid messages through media to inform/persuade
Middleman buying bulk, selling to retailers

walkthroughs.body_html:
Promotion isn't just adverts: advertising, sales promotion, PR, personal selling.

Match the method to the audience: TikTok for teens, trade shows for B2B.

Direct: more control and margin, but you need to handle delivery/customer service.

Indirect via wholesalers/retailers: wider reach, less control, smaller margin per unit.

Top marks: check whether the 4 Ps fit the target market.

A premium product needs a premium price, premium outlets and premium promotion. Inconsistency confuses customers.

mcqs.q: A BOGOF offer is an example.
Selling direct from a producer's website is.

numericals.q: An advert costs £4,000 and generates 200 extra sales at £25 profit each. What is the net gain, in £?
